name: The Null Hypothesis
source:
You are a mutant whose abilities emerge in dramatic fashion when you are attacked by an ancient and malevolent entity. You are taken in by Charles Xavier, who runs a school for mutants with the goal of protecting them and helping them learn to control their powers.
Upon arriving at the school, you meet a host of characters fulfilling different roles at the school, including Storm, Rogue, X-23, and Jean Grey.
You quickly learn that all of these characters are… single. Some are interested in you from the start; others think you are beneath them. Through various interactions, scenes, and events, you can change how the characters view and respond to you.
As you explore the school and your growing powers, global events will transpire that test the strength and nature of your budding relationships.
translation:
你是一个变种人，当你受到一个古老而恶毒的实体的攻击时，你的能力会以戏剧性的方式出现。你被查尔斯·泽维尔收留，他开办了一所变种人学校，目的是保护他们并帮助他们学会控制自己的力量。
到达学校后，你会遇到许多在学校扮演不同角色的角色，包括暴风女、盗贼、X-23和琴·葛雷。
你很快就会发现所有这些角色都是……单身。有些人从一开始就对你感兴趣；有些人从一开始就对你感兴趣；其他人认为你低于他们。通过各种互动、场景和事件，你可以改变角色对你的看法和反应。
当你探索学校和你不断增长的力量时，全球事件将会发生，考验你正在萌芽的关系的强度和性质。
